question_text:
Which sentence is in the active voice?

A) The classroom was cleaned by the DepEd personnel.
B) The DepEd personnel cleaned the classroom.
C) The classroom had been cleaned by the DepEd personnel.
D) The classroom was being cleaned by the DepEd personnel.

options.text: The classroom was cleaned by the DepEd personnel.
The DepEd personnel cleaned the classroom.
The classroom had been cleaned by the DepEd personnel.
The classroom was being cleaned by the DepEd personnel.
